विडूरथ १

VIḌŪRATHA I . A king born in the family of bharata, the son of duṣyanta. The father of this king was suratha and his son was sārvabhauma. (bhāgavata, skandha 10).

विडूरथ २

VIḌŪRATHA II . Brother of dantavaktra. When Śrī kṛṣṇa had defeated dantavaktra, his brother viḍūratha came to fight with śrī kṛṣṇa and was killed in the fight. (bhāgavata, skandha 10).
